plugins.name: crosstalk
plugins.description: Session-to-session messaging and read-only consult between live Claude Code sessions on one machine. Default OFF, operator-gated.

plugins.name: session-atlas
plugins.description: The standing map of every Claude Code session on a machine: living HTML pages (search, gists, resume commands) plus an agent-safe find/resolve/import CLI. Multi-account aware, stdlib-only, no credentials — gists are written by your own session's model.
